units.rawText: Please don't tell anyone. This is "Lupus", my most popular role. She's not a hero, though, but a villain.

units.rawText: I tried to change it to look like a hero's outfit, but the kids kept calling me a baddie... Ironic, isn't it? I always wanted to be a hero, but I became famous as a villain.
